rcapsule: Reproducibility Capsules and Multi-Target Containerization for R

Source: R/rcapsule-package.R
rcapsule-package.Rd

Full-stack computational reproducibility compiler and verifier for R analysis repositories, Quarto manuscripts, R Markdown reports, R packages, targets pipelines, and Shiny applications.

Main Workflows

  • Scan projects: scan_project(), sysreqs_db(), resolve_sysreqs()

  • Compile & lint containers: compile_dockerfile(), compile_compose(), compile_apptainer(), lint_container_spec()

  • Cryptographic manifests & diffing: create_capsule_manifest(), read_capsule_manifest(), write_capsule_manifest(), sign_manifest(), verify_manifest_integrity(), diff_capsules()

  • Isolated verification & publishing: verify_capsule(), compare_artifacts(), render_certificate(), export_capsule_bundle(), build_capsule()
